preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 10**5 for N in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(T)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of stones N is between 1 and 100000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(A) == N and len(B) == N for N, A, B in [tuple(input().split()) for _ in range(T)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the lengths of strings A and B are both equal to N.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in A) for A in [input().split()[1] for _ in range(T)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, all characters in string A are lowercase alphabets.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in B) for B in [input().split()[2] for _ in range(T)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, all characters in string B are lowercase alphabets.

postconditions.description: The number of output strings is equal to the number of test cases T.

postconditions.expression: all(len(S) == 2 * N for N, S in zip([int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(T)], stdout.split()))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the length of the output string S is 2 * N.

postconditions.expression: all(all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in S) for S in stdout.split())
postconditions.description: For each test case, all characters in the output string S are lowercase alphabets.

postconditions.expression: all(S == ''.join(sorted(A + B, key=lambda x: (x, -1 if A.count(x) > B.count(x) else 1))) for N, A, B, S in zip([int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(T)], [input().split()[1] for _ in range(T)], [input().split()[2] for _ in range(T)], stdout.split()))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output string S is the lexicographically smallest string that can be formed by optimally alternating turns between Alice and Bob.
